Resolution Calculator

Aspect ratio and pixel dimensions. Free, no sign-up, works in your browser on desktop and mobile.

Frequently asked questions

How do I find an aspect ratio?

Divide width and height by their greatest common divisor. For example 2560×1440 reduces to 16:9. The calculator also scales dimensions to a new width while keeping the ratio.
